instructions: Copy A1 "Name of College/University" exactly as printed. Do not take Harvard's misaligned private A0 respondent fields, and never infer the name from a URL or any other cell.
description: Institution name printed in A1 "Name of College/University".

instructions: Return the printed academic-year label from the document title/edition only. Do not substitute any item-specific reporting period (for example a fall-snapshot term or a cohort year) for this document-level edition label.
description: Academic year label covered by the CDS.

instructions: Copy the A1 main-address city cell exactly as printed. Do not confuse with the separately reported admissions office city.
description: City of the institution's main mailing address, from A1.

instructions: Copy the A1 main-address state/region cell exactly as printed. Do not confuse with the separately reported admissions office state/region.
description: State or region of the institution's main mailing address, from A1.

instructions: Copy the A1 main-address country cell exactly as printed when present. Do not confuse with the separately reported admissions country.
description: Country of the institution's main mailing address, from A1.

instructions: Extract the A1 main institution website URL exactly as printed. Keep distinct from the online `application_url` and from the URL where the institution posts its CDS responses.
Extract the A1 admissions office email address exactly as printed. Keep distinct from the general institutional email address printed at A1.
description: Admissions office email address, from A1.

instructions: Extract the A1 online application URL only from its own separately labeled row. Do not reuse `main_website` when no distinct application URL is printed.
description: Separate online application URL, from A1, when printed.

instructions: Return the exact selected A2 control category using return IDs `public`, `private_nonprofit`, or `proprietary` for the visible labels "Public", "Private (nonprofit)", or "Proprietary". Never guess from school reputation or context.
description: Source of institutional control, from A2.

instructions: Return the exact selected A3 classification using return IDs `coeducational`, `mens_college`, or `womens_college` for the visible labels "Coeducational college", "Men's college", or "Women's college". This is the institution's undergraduate classification, not enrollment gender composition (see the `enrollment` domain for composition counts).
description: Undergraduate institution gender classification, from A3.

instructions: Return the selected A4 calendar category using return IDs `semester`, `quarter`, `trimester`, `four_one_four`, `continuous`, `differs_by_program`, or `other` for the visible labels "Semester", "Quarter", "Trimester", "4-1-4", "Continuous", "Differs by program", or "Other". Return the selected category, not any explanatory text beside it.
Return true only when the A5 "Bachelor's" checkbox is visibly checked and false only when the complete visible A5 checklist shows this box unambiguously unmarked.
description: Whether the institution offers the bachelor's degree, from the A5 checklist.

instructions: Return true only when the A5 "Master's" checkbox is visibly checked and false only when the complete visible A5 checklist shows this box unambiguously unmarked.
description: Whether the institution offers the master's degree, from the A5 checklist.

instructions: Return true only when the A5 "Doctoral degree research/scholarship" checkbox is visibly checked and false only when the complete visible A5 checklist shows this box unambiguously unmarked. Accept the same label with a hyphen or dash before "research/scholarship" as a version spelling alias. Do not conflate with the professional-practice or other doctoral rows.
description: Whether the institution offers a doctoral degree classified as research/scholarship, from the A5 checklist.
